TrueBranch.Text:
Oooh, that's new you think to yourself as you listen to your heels clicking on the floor.

That's a really sexy sound. You could get used to walking in these heels.

Wait, where did that thought come from, you think to yourself. You must be a bit flustered from lack of food or something.

Nodes.Text: You bravely drive on...trying to find somewhere to wait out the storm.
Unfortunately, you slide off the road and get stuck.
Great!  Now what will you do?!

Rooms.Name: Backyard
Rooms.Description: You don't want to be out here long.  You'll freeze to death!

TrueBranch.Text: You search through the cupboards and find a pack of matches!

FalseBranch.Text: You find nothing else of value.

TrueBranch.Text: You search through the drawers and find a corkscrew!

FalseBranch.Text: You find nothing else of value.

Rooms.Name: Foyer
Rooms.Description: A stately foyer.  The ceilings are impressively tall.  This house didn't look this nice from outside, although it was hard to see much of anything in the storm!

Nodes.Text:
You jump as the door slams behind you!

You check the door and find that you can't seem to get it open again. Perhaps it has frozen shut due to the cold weather!

Your clothes have gotten wet and you are starting to freeze. You better hurry up and get out of those clothes!

Rooms.Name: Your Car
Rooms.Description: Your car is basic but functional.

Rooms.Name: Inside Hummer
Rooms.Description: The seats are fine leather.  It still has that new car smell.  This is definitely an upgraded vehicle!

TrueBranch.Text: [Command Fallback: "CT_ENDGAME" | Args: ["","The Hummer roars to life and you floor it.  A somewhat changed individual, but at least you got out of the house!","","",""]]

FalseBranch.Text: You will probably need some keys to make the car go.
